| [0095](0095-weekly-scheduled-advisory-check.md) | A weekly scheduled cargo-deny advisories run, the only schedule trigger | Accepted | 2026-10-22 | advisories.yml runs only `cargo deny check advisories`, weekly and on dispatch, so a RustSec advisory published after a release is seen within a week; it is the repository's only schedule trigger, approved as cheap, and no precedent for scheduling heavy workflows. |
| [0096](0096-public-github-releases-no-package-index.md) | Releases are public GitHub Release assets; no package index, crates unpublished | Accepted | 2026-10-22 | pdf-extract is released as wheels, sdist and SHA256SUMS on the public repository's GitHub Releases, installed by URL pinned by hash; nothing goes to PyPI or crates.io, which closes design spec §17.2 Q1 and, for wheels, Q6 (the golden re-bless is a RELEASING.md step). |
| [0097](0097-one-time-redaction-for-the-public-snapshot.md) | The public snapshot carries a one-time redaction, enforced by the wordlist test | Accepted | 2026-11-01 | Before the internal repository is exported as the public snapshot, the tracked tree is redacted once by a fixed mapping (the consumer's name and code identifiers, the usage survey and its section labels, the work address, internal issue/PR/commit references); this is the single sanctioned exception to never rewriting an Accepted ADR's body, and wordlist.rs keeps the source terms out afterwards. |
| [0098](0098-pull-requests-run-ci-automatically.md) | Pull requests run CI automatically | Accepted | 2026-11-02 | Now that the repository is public, ci.yml runs on every pull request into main (on GitHub's merge ref; forks wait for a maintainer's approval) as well as on pushes to main and by dispatch. |
